# telnyx_display_identity_record_phone_number (Resource)

A phone number that shows a DIR's branded identity when it calls. Telnyx vets the number; status says how far.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_display_identity_record_phone_number" "main" {
  dir_id       = telnyx_display_identity_record.acme.id
  phone_number = "+13125550100"

  documents = [{
    document_id   = telnyx_document.loa.id
    document_type = "letter_of_authorization"
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dir_id` (String) The dir id.
- `documents` (Attributes List) Supporting documents covering this batch. At least one entry with `document_type: letter_of_authorization` is required - the LOA authorises Telnyx to register these numbers under the DIR. Each `document_id` must come from the Telnyx Documents API. Additional document types (e.g. business registration) may be included alongside the LOA. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--documents))
- `phone_number` (String) The phone number to show the display identity for, in E.164 format with a leading `+`.

### Read-Only

- `batch_id` (String) Id of the batch this number was vetted as part of.
- `created_at` (String)
- `enterprise_id` (String)
- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `loa_document_id` (String) Id of the Letter of Authorization document attached to this number's batch.
- `rejection_reason` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rejection_reason))
- `status` (String) Phone-number lifecycle status. - `submitted` / `in_review` - Telnyx is reviewing the batch this number belongs to. - `verified` - approved; the DIR's display identity will be shown on outbound calls from this number. - `unsuccessful` - Telnyx rejected this submission; the customer may re-add to retry. - `suspended` - temporarily disabled (e.g. by an active infringement claim on the DIR). - `expired` - verification expired; re-add to renew. - `permanently_rejected` - terminal; cannot be re-added on this or any other DIR you own.
- `updated_at` (String)
- `verified_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--documents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `documents`

Required:

- `document_id` (String) Id returned by the Telnyx Documents API after you upload the file (upload via `POST /v2/documents`; see https://developers.telnyx.com/api/documents). The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `document_type` (String) Type of supporting document. Pick the closest match to what the file actually contains; `other` triggers manual vetting and may slow approval. The matching short_name reference list is at `GET /v2/dir/document_types`. One of `articles_of_incorporation`, `bank_reference_letter`, `bank_statement`, `business_credit_report`, `business_license`, `business_registration`, `certificate_of_good_standing`, `ein_letter`, `government_id`, `letter_of_authorization`, `other`, `professional_license`, `tax_document`, `trademark_registration`, `utility_bill`, `website_ownership`. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

Optional:

- `description` (String) An optional note describing this document, for example what it proves. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.


<a id="nestedatt--rejection_reason"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rejection_reason`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String)
- `detail` (String)
- `message` (String) Customer-visible free-text comment from the Telnyx vetting team. Only the first entry of `rejection_reasons` carries this; the rest are `null`.
- `title` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_display_identity_record_phone_number.example <dir_id>/<id>
```
